'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)|Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Rafah offensive]]
****At least six [[Palestinian]]s are killed in [[Rafah]] in the [[Gaza Strip]], as [[Israel]]i tanks re-enter [[Shuja'iyya]] and parts of northern Gaza, displacing more than 60,000 people. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/30/six-palestinians-killed-as-israeli-forces-pound-southern-northern-gaza (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-tanks-advance-into-areas-north-south-gaza-fighting-rages-2024-06-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**18 IDF soldiers are injured by a Hezbollah drone attack on the Golan Heights.[https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2540841/middle-east (Arab News)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
***At least one person is killed and ten others are injured when a [[Russia]]n [[guided bomb]] hits a postal sorting hub in [[Kharkiv]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-06-30/war-in-ukraine-deadly-russian-glide-bomb-hits-postal-hub-in-kharkiv (Bloomberg)]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Defence Ministry]] says that [[Russian Armed Forces|its forces]] have taken the villages of [[Spirne, Donetsk Oblast|Spirne]] and [[Novooleksandrivka, Kramatorsk Raion, Donetsk Oblast|Novooleksandrivka]] in [[Ukraine]]'s eastern [[Donetsk Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-it-takes-over-two-villages-ukraines-donetsk-region-2024-07-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 offensive (2022–present)|M23 offensive]]
***[[March 23 Movement|M23]] rebels take control of Kirumba, the largest town in [[Lubero Territory]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], as they continue north. [https://www.voanews.com/a/m23-continues-to-gain-ground-in-volatile-east-dr-congo-/7678541.html (VOA)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[Cinema of the United States|American film]] ''[[Inside Out 2]]'' surpasses $1 billion in worldwide box office earnings in less than three weeks, the fastest of any [[animated film]] in [[List of highest-grossing animated films|history]]. [https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/inside-out-2-hits-1-billion-global-box-office-2024-06-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 European floods]]
**At least four people are killed and two others are missing after landslides and torrential floods in [[Ticino]] and [[Valais]], [[Switzerland]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/two-dead-one-missing-after-swiss-landslide-police-say-2024-06-30/ (Reuters)]
*A [[China|Chinese]] [[Tianlong-3]] rocket stage is accidentally launched during a [[static fire test]] in [[Gongyi]], [[Henan]], [[China]], causing it to crash and explode. No casualties are reported. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/06/30/asia/space-pioneer-rocket-crashes-accidental-launch-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*A [[propane]] tank explosion at a restaurant in [[İzmir|Izmir]], [[Turkey]], kills five people and injures 63 others. [https://apnews.com/article/turkey-restaurant-explosion-izmir-propane-tank-648b78fbd8ea45a789ce0aa319e38b09 (AP)]

** [[Hurricane Beryl (2024)|Hurricane Beryl]] undergoes [[rapid intensification]] and strengthens into a [[Category 4 hurricane]], becoming the earliest Category 4 [[Atlantic hurricane]] on record. [https://apnews.com/article/hurricane-beryl-caribbean-islands-aaae273e307658866fdd27f9f2c76592 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 French legislative election]]
**[[2024 French protests against the far-right]]
***Thousands of left-wing protesters gather in cities across France to protest the [[National Rally]]'s lead in election polls, while showing support for the [[New Popular Front]] left-wing alliance. [https://www.france24.com/en/video/20240630-thousands-gather-in-paris-square-to-protest-far-right-national-rally-party (France 24)] [https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/legislatives/en-direct-manifestations-sauvages-resultats-legislatives-premier-tour-20240630 (Le Figaro)]

[https://apnews.com/article/france-election-far-right-macron-f07061a929ed8eaad0e714e948159cab (AP)]
*[[2024 Uruguayan presidential primaries]]
**Uruguayans vote to elect the presidential candidates for all political parties that are running in the [[2024 Uruguayan general election|general election on 27 October]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/uruguay-holds-primary-elections-opposition-left-gains-ground-2024-06-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Conscription of yeshiva students]]
**Thousands of [[Haredi Judaism|Haredi Jewish]] men protest in [[Jerusalem]], [[Israel]], against a recent [[Supreme Court of Israel|Supreme Court]] ruling that ordered the [[conscript]]ion of Haredi [[yeshiva]] students, clashing with [[Israel Police]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-draft-ultraorthodox-gaza-war-5b17485638c0a3e578b179a8bbf44fe8 (AP)]
*The [[Bulgarian Orthodox Church]] elects [[Daniel of Bulgaria|Metropolitan Daniel of Vidin]], a member of the pro-[[Russia]]n faction among the church's senior clergy, as [[Patriarch of All Bulgaria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/bulgaria-patriarch-ukraine-russia-2a64e226bd085699d405d5aa9d075198 (AP)]
